propositions: The loud refusal at _pai_check_config:718 rejects base_url and api_key configuration that is already parsed by config.py and documented as working in llm-framework.md, making documentation false.

base_url and api_key must be treated as provider configuration (not provider selection), injected via an openai builder in the provider factory only when base_url is set, leaving bare openai model strings on the lazy path.

An OpenAI-compatible endpoint is not guaranteed to support strict json_schema output, so the builder must override model_profile to set supports_json_schema_output=False while preserving other capabilities from the openai profile.
The openai SDK must remain optional for runtime (agents extra unchanged) but must be added to dev extra so tests can exercise the builder end-to-end without CI silently skipping acceptance criteria.
Non-loopback ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL already routes through a gateway by accident; this must be documented and tested so the behavior is intentional and cannot regress.
